title: Kasol, Kheerganga & Tosh
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.
highlights: Kheerganga trek (12 km trail from Barsheni)
Overnight camping at Kheerganga with a bonfire dinner
Kasol market and cafes by the Parvati River
Guest house night in Tosh village
overview:
A Parvati Valley backpacking trip: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** Kasol, Kheerganga & Tosh group trip leaves Delhi in the evening in an AC push-back vehicle and reaches Kasol the next morning. There is a dinner halt on the way, at your own cost.

Day 1 is for the Kasol market and cafes, an evening hike to Chalal village and a bonfire at the stay. Day 2 is the Kheerganga trek, a 12 km trail from Barsheni, ending with dinner by a bonfire and a night in camps. Day 3 treks back down to Barsheni and drives to Tosh village for a guest house stay. Day 4 has a hike to a nearby waterfall before the return to Kasol and the overnight journey to Delhi. Prices start at ₹9,999 per person on triple sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure to Kasol in the evening
itinerary.content:
Depart for Kasol in the evening.
Overnight journey in an AC push-back vehicle.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Reach Kasol | Local market | Chalal village | Cafe hopping
itinerary.content:
Reach Kasol by morning and check in.
Leisure time: explore the Kasol market, try the local cafes or relax by the Parvati River.
In the evening, hike to Chalal village for views of Parvati Valley.
Spend time at the cafes in Kasol, then return to the stay for a bonfire.
Overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Barsheni | Kheerganga trek | Camping
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and, after breakfast, head for Kheerganga.
Transfer in private vehicles to Barsheni, where the trek starts.
The Kheerganga trail is 12 km, with a moderate difficulty level.
Walk through Parvati Valley, surrounded by snow-capped mountains.
Reach the Kheerganga campsite and have dinner by the bonfire.
Overnight stay in camps.

itinerary.title: Trek down to Barsheni | Transfer to Tosh
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, trek down to Barsheni.
Drive to Tosh village.
Hike through the village to reach the guest house.
Dinner and bonfire.

itinerary.title: Waterfall hike | Return to Kasol | Departure
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, hike to the nearby waterfall and spend some time there.
Trek down and return to Kasol.
Head back to Delhi.
Reach Delhi by the next morning.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi in the evening for an overnight journey to Kasol in an AC push-back vehicle. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: How much does the Kasol, Kheerganga & Tosh trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹9,999 per person on triple sharing and ₹10,499 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

3 nights of accommodation as per the itinerary, 6 meals (3 breakfasts and 3 dinners), transfers to and from Delhi in an AC tempo traveller or AC deluxe bus, sightseeing as per the itinerary, a bonfire with music and a trip captain.

faqs.q: How long is the Kheerganga trek?
faqs.a: The Kheerganga trail is 12 km, with a moderate difficulty level. It starts from Barsheni on Day 2, and you trek back down to Barsheni on Day 3 after a night in camps.
The first night is in Kasol, the second night is in camps at Kheerganga and the third night is in a guest house in Tosh village.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
